---level20 script---

local isPlayingDemo = false
local countFail = 0
local isSkip = true
local hasViewedStory = global.getBool("lvl20_b1")

if not hasViewedStory or not game.isRestart() then
	repeat
		if hasViewedStory then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		game.setUserInputEnabled(false)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(false)
		script.delay(1)
		sound.play("44-1")
		if dialog.show("Level20-1", faceJingya) ==1 then break end
		camera.setFollowRoleMode(false)
		camera.gotoPosition(620,440)
		if dialog.show("Level20-2", faceZhoumei) ==1 then break end
		sound.play("60-1")
		if dialog.show("Level20-3", faceBujie) ==1 then break end
		sound.play("60-4")
		if dialog.show("Level20-4", faceWunai) ==1 then break end
		if dialog.show("Level20-5", faceDeyi) ==1 then break end
		camera.gotoRole()
		sound.play("50-2")
		if dialog.show("Level20-6", faceRenzhen) ==1 then break end
		if dialog.showMinTime("Level20-7", faceZhoumei,0) ==1 then break end
		sound.play("54-1")
		if dialog.show("Level20-8", faceWeixiao) ==1 then break end
		camera.setFollowRoleMode(true)
		
		--set story viewed flag
        global.setBool("lvl20_b1")

		game.restartTiming()
		game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
		isPlayingDemo = false

		isSkip = false
	until true
end

if isSkip then
	camera.gotoRole()
	camera.setFollowRoleMode(true)
	dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
	game.resumeLogic()
	game.showTutorialDiagram(0)
	game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
	role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
	game.restartTiming()
end
